name: STA302H1 — Socratic Discovery (Simple Linear Regression)
description: Yᵢ=β₀+β₁Xᵢ+εᵢ, εᵢ~N(0,σ²). β₁=slope, β₀=intercept. OLS: minimize Σ(Yᵢ-β₀-β₁Xᵢ)². β̂₁=S_xy/S_xx, β̂₀=Ȳ-β̂₁X̄.

steps.template_en: Yᵢ=β₀+β₁Xᵢ+εᵢ, εᵢ~N(0,σ²). β₁=slope, β₀=intercept. OLS: minimize Σ(Yᵢ-β₀-β₁Xᵢ)². β̂₁=S_xy/S_xx, β̂₀=Ȳ-β̂₁X̄.
Interpretation: Y=house price, X=size. β̂₁=0.5: each additional ft² → expected price ↑ $500. β̂₀=50: expected price at 0 ft² is $50K (extrapolation).
steps.template_zh: 解释：β̂₁=0.5：每增加一平方英尺，预期价格增加$500。β̂₀=50：外推可能无意义。

steps.template_en: ANOVA: SS_total=SS_reg+SS_res. R²=SS_reg/SS_total = variance explained. H₀: β₁=0: t=β̂₁/SE(β̂₁)~t_{n-2} or F=MS_reg/MS_res~F_{1,n-2}. t²=F → same test.
Assumptions: (1) Linearity: E[Y|X]=β₀+β₁X. (2) Independence. (3) Homoscedasticity: Var(εᵢ)=σ². (4) Normality for exact inference. OLS: E[β̂]=β (unbiased), Var(β̂)=σ²(XᵀX)⁻¹.
steps.template_zh: 假设：(1)线性。(2)独立。(3)同方差。(4)正态性用于精确推断。OLS：无偏。

steps.template_en: In R: lm(y~x). (1) Extract β̂₀, β̂₁, R², F. (2) Test H₀:β₁=0. (3) Scatterplot + regression line. (4) Residuals vs fitted — assumptions hold? (5) Predict Y for new X + 95% PI.
steps.template_zh: 在R中：(1)提取系数、R²、F。(2)检验H₀。(3)散点图+回归线。(4)残差诊断。(5)预测+95%预测区间。

steps.template_en: 'Regression to the mean' (Galton): children of tall parents taller than avg but shorter than parents. |β₁|<1 → predicted Y CLOSER TO MEAN than X. NOT artifact — real!
steps.template_zh: '均值回归'(Galton)：高个子父母的孩子比平均高但比父母矮。|β₁|<1→预测Y比X更接近均值。
